works.title: Saint Sofian of Antim: The Urban Hesychast
works.author: Archimandrite Sofian Boghiu
works.blurb: The counsels and spiritual teaching of Father Sofian Boghiu, abbot and iconographer of Antim Monastery in Bucharest, who kept the inner stillness of the Hesychasts amid the city and the trials of the communist years.
